description_compelling: A structural rewrite to electricity generation, transmission, fuel pricing, or energy-mix targets — net-zero legislation, subsidy reform, grid reorganization, nuclear restart. Regulatory quality, government effectiveness, and trade openness shift first. Common in OECD energy transitions and in subsidy-heavy emerging markets under fiscal pressure.
